lines.zh: 腕龙迈开柱子般的长腿
lines.en: Brachiosaurus swings legs like pillars.

lines.zh: 每一步都震得地面发闷
lines.en: Each step makes the ground thud.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到树冠高处
lines.en: Its neck reaches into the treetops.

lines.zh: 它缓缓挪过开阔的平原
lines.en: It plods across the open plain.

lines.zh: 前腿比后腿长，走路像上坡
lines.en: Longer forelegs make it walk uphill.

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后慢慢划着空气
lines.en: Its tail idly scythes the air behind.

lines.zh: 它踩过灌木，灌木直接消失
lines.en: Bushes simply vanish beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 膝弯下去，再稳稳撑起
lines.en: The knee bends, then lifts with care.

lines.zh: 它边吃边走，从不停下
lines.en: It grazes as it goes, never stopping.

lines.zh: 影子先到，身体后到
lines.en: Its shadow arrives before its body.

lines.zh: 小树被它侧身让开
lines.en: It angles its bulk around a sapling.

lines.zh: 脚掌落处扬起一圈尘土
lines.en: A ring of dust puffs from each footfall.

lines.zh: 它沿着河岸一路啃过去
lines.en: It strips the riverside as it travels.

lines.zh: 走得不快，但没有停过
lines.en: Not fast, but it never halts.

lines.zh: 脖子左右摆动，像吊臂
lines.en: Its neck swings like a crane arm.

lines.zh: 两只腕龙一前一后错开走
lines.en: Two brachiosaurs file past each other.

lines.zh: 脚下的石子被碾进泥里
lines.en: Pebbles are pressed into the mud.

lines.zh: 它绕过岩丘，继续向前
lines.en: It rounds a rocky rise and carries on.

lines.zh: 腕龙站着，像一座活的丘陵
lines.en: Brachiosaurus stands like a living hill.

lines.zh: 它慢慢咀嚼，下颌左右磨
lines.en: It chews slowly, jaw grinding sideways.

lines.zh: 长脖子抬高，巡视整片平原
lines.en: Its long neck lifts to survey the plain.

lines.zh: 一阵风吹过，它眨了下眼
lines.en: A gust passes; it blinks once.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子凑到树顶嗅了嗅
lines.en: It sniffs the crown of a tree.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张一合，声音很沉
lines.en: Its nostrils flare with a deep sound.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸像远处的风箱
lines.en: Its breathing is a distant bellows.

lines.zh: 尾尖无意识地轻拍地面
lines.en: Its tail tip pats the ground absently.

lines.zh: 它抬头看云，看了很久
lines.en: It looks at the clouds for a long while.

lines.zh: 脖子靠着树干蹭了蹭
lines.en: It rubs its neck against a trunk.

lines.zh: 它对着水洼低下长颈
lines.en: It lowers its neck to a puddle.

lines.zh: 水面映出一整个模糊的巨影
lines.en: The water holds a blurred giant shadow.

lines.zh: 它打了个长长的响鼻
lines.en: It lets out a long, wet snort.

lines.zh: 眼皮垂下来，又勉强抬起
lines.en: Its lids droop, then lift again.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在它背上歇脚
lines.en: A bird settles on its back to rest.

lines.zh: 它完全没有要动的意思
lines.en: It has no intention of moving.

lines.zh: 腕龙低下脖子看你
lines.en: Brachiosaurus lowers its neck to see you.

lines.zh: 巨大的眼睛近在眼前
lines.en: A huge eye fills your view.

lines.zh: 它歪头，把你从头看到脚
lines.en: It tilts its head and scans you over.

lines.zh: 鼻息吹乱了你的头发
lines.en: Its breath messes up your hair.

lines.zh: 它对你毫无兴趣，只是好奇
lines.en: No hostility here, only curiosity.

lines.zh: 你还没它一条腿高
lines.en: You barely reach one of its legs.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻你的肩膀
lines.en: It sniffs your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它轻轻把你顶开半步
lines.en: It nudges you gently aside.

lines.zh: 那双眼里没有半点敌意
lines.en: There is no hostility in those eyes.

lines.zh: 它低头，让你摸到鼻梁
lines.en: It lowers its head within your reach.

lines.zh: 它打量你很久，然后转头吃叶
lines.en: After a long look it turns back to leaves.

lines.zh: 腕龙把你当成路边的石头
lines.en: To it, you are a rock by the path.

lines.zh: 腕龙吃痛，猛地抬起前腿
lines.en: Hurt, it throws its forelegs up.

lines.zh: 它低鸣一声，退开了半步
lines.en: With a low cry it backs off half a step.

lines.zh: 巨兽的皮肤上留下一道印子
lines.en: A mark is left on that thick hide.

lines.zh: 它甩动长颈，想把痛甩掉
lines.en: It swings its neck to shake off the pain.

lines.zh: 它喘得很重，仍不肯跑
lines.en: Breathing hard, it still refuses to flee.

lines.zh: 它的脚在地上不安地刨
lines.en: Its feet paw the ground in distress.

lines.zh: 伤口很小，对它是小事
lines.en: The wound is small by its measure.

lines.zh: 它抬起鼻子，发出求助的鸣叫
lines.en: It raises its snout and calls for help.

lines.zh: 幼崽被它护得更紧了
lines.en: The calves are pulled in tighter.

lines.zh: 它慢慢转头，记住了这笔账
lines.en: It turns slowly and remembers the debt.

lines.zh: 腕龙闻到了嫩叶的味道
lines.en: Brachiosaurus catches the smell of fresh leaves.

lines.zh: 它把脖子朝你这边弯下来
lines.en: Its neck curves down toward you.

lines.zh: 它盯着你手里的树枝不放
lines.en: It fixes on the branch in your hand.

lines.zh: 它慢吞吞地挪近一步
lines.en: It shuffles one slow step closer.

lines.zh: 舌头卷过叶簇，一点不剩
lines.en: Its tongue sweeps the leaves clean.

lines.zh: 它试着用鼻尖碰你的手
lines.en: It tries to touch your hand with its snout.

lines.zh: 吃完还想要，眼睛一直跟着你
lines.en: Finished, its eyes follow you for more.

lines.zh: 它低下头，露出讨食的姿态
lines.en: It dips its head in a begging pose.

lines.zh: 喉咙发出满足的低音
lines.en: A pleased rumble comes from its throat.

lines.zh: 它用嘴轻轻叼走枝条
lines.en: It takes the branch with a gentle tug.

lines.zh: 绿叶在它齿间沙沙作响
lines.en: Green leaves rustle between its teeth.

lines.zh: 它耐心等你再递一些
lines.en: It waits patiently for another handful.

lines.zh: 它差点把整丛灌木连根拔起
lines.en: It nearly uproots the whole shrub.

lines.zh: 它的鼻子跟着你的手移动
lines.en: Its snout tracks the movement of your hand.

lines.zh: 它满足地闭上眼嚼着
lines.en: It chews with its eyes half closed.

lines.zh: 吃到好东西，它脚步都轻了
lines.en: Fed well, even its steps grow lighter.

lines.zh: 你撞在腕龙的腿上，像撞墙
lines.en: You hit its leg like a wall.

lines.zh: 它被碰了一下，只是侧了侧身
lines.en: Touched, it merely shifts sideways.

lines.zh: 你被它的大腿轻轻推偏
lines.en: Its thigh eases you off course.

lines.zh: 它低头看你，怕踩到你
lines.en: It looks down, careful not to step on you.

lines.zh: 它挪开脚，给你留出空间
lines.en: It moves a foot to give you room.

lines.zh: 碰撞对它是件小事
lines.en: To a creature this size, a bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 它尾巴扫过，你退了两步
lines.en: Its tail sweeps by; you take two steps back.

lines.zh: 它慢慢绕开，不与你争路
lines.en: It ambles around rather than contest the path.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀被它的脖子压了一下
lines.en: Its neck presses briefly on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 两头巨兽相撞，你被夹在中间
lines.en: Two giants meet; you are caught between.

lines.zh: 两头腕龙把脖子缠在一起
lines.en: Two brachiosaurs twine their necks.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子轻推伴侣的肩
lines.en: It nudges its partner's shoulder with its nose.

lines.zh: 低沉的共鸣在胸腔里滚
lines.en: A deep resonance rolls through its chest.

lines.zh: 它们并排啃同一棵树
lines.en: They strip the same tree side by side.

lines.zh: 它守在伴侣身侧慢慢踱步
lines.en: It paces slowly at its partner's flank.

lines.zh: 长颈交错，像两座塔靠拢
lines.en: Two towers lean, necks crossing.

lines.zh: 它把最嫩的叶子留给对方
lines.en: It leaves the tenderest leaves for its mate.

lines.zh: 两只巨兽的呼吸渐渐同步
lines.en: The breathing of two giants falls into step.

lines.zh: 它轻轻蹭着伴侣的侧腹
lines.en: It rubs gently along its partner's flank.

lines.zh: 这片平原暂时只属于它们
lines.en: For now the plain belongs to them alone.

lines.zh: 腕龙用舌头卷起地上的枝叶
lines.en: Its tongue curls up the leaves on the ground.

lines.zh: 它低头把东西含进嘴里
lines.en: It dips its head and takes it in.

lines.zh: 它把果子连枝一起咬走
lines.en: It takes the fruit with the branch attached.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅，才决定吃不吃
lines.en: It sniffs first, then decides.

lines.zh: 它不慌不忙地嚼完
lines.en: It chews it through without hurry.

lines.zh: 东西在它嘴里显得太小
lines.en: The item looks tiny in its mouth.

lines.zh: 它把食物推到幼崽面前
lines.en: It pushes the food toward a calf.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子把落果拨到一起
lines.en: It noses the fallen fruit into a pile.

lines.zh: 它把枝条叼得高高的
lines.en: It carries the branch high overhead.

lines.zh: 它吃完了，舔了舔嘴唇
lines.en: Done eating, it licks its lips.

lines.zh: 腕龙转过头，盯住了你
lines.en: Brachiosaurus turns its head and stares.

lines.zh: 它把脖子抬高，发出警告
lines.en: It raises its neck in warning.

lines.zh: 前脚抬起，又重重落下
lines.en: A forefoot lifts, then slams down.

lines.zh: 它不想打，但已经准备防守
lines.en: It would rather not fight, but it is braced.

lines.zh: 一声低鸣滚过平原
lines.en: A low call rolls across the plain.

lines.zh: 它把你挡在幼崽之外
lines.en: It puts itself between you and the calves.

lines.zh: 长脖子缓缓摆正方向
lines.en: Its neck swings around to face you.

lines.zh: 它的脚开始不安地刨地
lines.en: Its feet begin to paw the dirt.

lines.zh: 这头巨兽终于认真了
lines.en: The giant has finally taken you seriously.

lines.zh: 它用影子把你整个盖住
lines.en: Its shadow swallows you whole.

lines.zh: 腕龙盯着你，慢慢逼近
lines.en: Brachiosaurus watches and closes slowly.

lines.zh: 它用身体把路堵住
lines.en: It blocks the way with its bulk.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地面都在响
lines.en: Every step makes the ground answer.

lines.zh: 它低头试探你的位置
lines.en: It dips its head to test where you are.

lines.zh: 它不着急，时间站在它这边
lines.en: No rush; time is on its side.

lines.zh: 它把幼崽护到身后
lines.en: It shields the calves behind itself.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出两股白气
lines.en: Two jets of warm breath leave its nostrils.

lines.zh: 它的影子一直罩着你
lines.en: Its shadow never leaves you.

lines.zh: 它停下，等你自己退开
lines.en: It halts and waits for you to retreat.

lines.zh: 你退一步，它才收一分势
lines.en: You step back; it eases off a little.

lines.zh: 腕龙前脚砸下，尘土炸开
lines.en: A forefoot crashes down in a burst of dust.

lines.zh: 它用脖子横扫过来
lines.en: Its neck sweeps across like a beam.

lines.zh: 它顶你一下，你飞出老远
lines.en: One shove sends you flying.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩过，像攻城锤
lines.en: The tail swings like a battering ram.

lines.zh: 它踩向你，你滚开半米
lines.en: It stamps; you roll clear by inches.

lines.zh: 它低吼着又抬起前腿
lines.en: Snorting, it lifts the foreleg again.

lines.zh: 肩膀一撞，你贴地滑出去
lines.en: A shoulder check slides you along the dirt.

lines.zh: 它只用了三分力
lines.en: It is holding most of its strength back.

lines.zh: 一击未中，它缓缓转身
lines.en: Missing, it turns its bulk around.

lines.zh: 它的动作慢，但重量惊人
lines.en: Slow, but the weight behind it is terrible.

lines.zh: 树冠忽然被顶开一个口子
lines.en: The treetops part as something rises.

lines.zh: 腕龙从雾里露出长脖子
lines.en: A long neck emerges from the mist.

lines.zh: 先是一声低鸣，然后是脚步
lines.en: First a low call, then footsteps.

lines.zh: 平原尽头走来一个巨影
lines.en: A giant shape walks out of the far plain.

lines.zh: 它啃掉一株树苗，走进视野
lines.en: It strips a sapling and steps into view.

lines.zh: 地面开始有节奏地发颤
lines.en: The ground begins to throb in rhythm.

lines.zh: 一只幼崽紧跟在它腿边
lines.en: A calf tags along beside its leg.

lines.zh: 它的背脊在夕阳下很亮
lines.en: Its ridged back shines in the low sun.

lines.zh: 它停下，伸长脖子望了望
lines.en: It halts and stretches its neck to look.

lines.zh: 一群鸟被它惊得飞散
lines.en: A flock scatters as it arrives.

lines.zh: 它慢慢踩过河滩
lines.en: It wades slowly over the riverbank.

lines.zh: 这片平原有了新的主人
lines.en: The plain has a new master.

lines.zh: 火燎到腿上，它惊得连退
lines.en: Flame catches its leg and it lurches back.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，它的腿被压得发颤
lines.en: Landing from a height, its legs tremble.

lines.zh: 水漫过鼻孔，它拼命抬头
lines.en: Water fills its nostrils; it strains to lift its head.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的土石砸在它背上
lines.en: Blast debris hammers its back.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进它的厚皮里
lines.en: An arrow sticks in its thick hide.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量让它的长颈抽搐
lines.en: Strange force makes its long neck twitch.

lines.zh: 饿得厉害，它的脖子垂了下来
lines.en: Starving, its neck hangs low.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着脖子灌下，它踉跄
lines.en: Lightning runs down its neck; it staggers.

lines.zh: 虚空扯住四腿，它绝望地挣扎
lines.en: The void grips all four legs; it thrashes.
